title: Non-Invasive Scoped Metadata Annotations vs. Core Kernel Mutability

claims.assertion: When introducing architectural or structural abstractions (such as 4-tier DI scopes), prefer non-invasive inspection adapters and read-only metadata annotators over mutating the core IoC kernel container constructor, preventing cascading breakage across registered plugins

context: Grafting new domain concepts directly onto the core ServiceContext constructor breaks backwards compatibility with existing plugins, lifecycle tests, and transaction managers.
distilled_learning: Implement structural analysis as a standalone inspector (e.g. ScopeInspector) that traverses the existing parent-child ServiceContext hierarchy without mutating core kernel classes. This provides full introspection capabilities while preserving 100% test and plugin backward compatibility.
